entries.zh: 减轻刑罚；宽减刑惩
entries.en: to lessen punishments; to mitigate penalties

entries.zh: 消气；平息怒气
entries.en: to dispel anger; to cool down

entries.zh: 消恨；消除怨恨
entries.en: to dispel resentment; to lessen hatred

entries.zh: 消脓；消散脓液（外科消散痈肿）
entries.en: to resolve pus; to draw off purulent matter
entries.notes: L 栏 mercería 于义不通，疑为 materia（脓液、脓性物质）之讹读；H 栏「消膿」正谓消散脓液，M/R 两栏 siān 亦合，据此参定。

entries.zh: 射弩；发射弩箭
entries.en: to shoot a crossbow
entries.notes: R 栏 siē ân 与「射弩」对音不合，疑窜行或误抄；L/H/M 三栏（Disparar la Ballesta / 射弩 / chià lōu）互证一致，故仍定此义。

entries.zh: 挽弓；拉弓开弦（射箭）
entries.en: to draw a bow

entries.zh: 打手铳；开火铳（手把短枪）
entries.en: to fire a handgun; to discharge an arquebus

entries.zh: 放铳；开炮（发射火炮）
entries.en: to fire a cannon; to discharge artillery

entries.zh: 放炮；燃放爆竹、火箭
entries.en: to set off firecrackers or rockets

entries.zh: 胡说；言语错乱（「三」疑为记音字）
entries.en: to talk nonsense; to rave
entries.notes: H 栏「三」与「胡说」义不合，M 栏并列 sâm、bōng、confuso 三注，疑「三」为记音或残字，仅 L 栏 disparatar 可定其义。

entries.zh: 谬；荒谬之言，说错话
entries.en: absurd; erroneous; to talk absurdly

entries.zh: 胡说；妄言（H 栏「渵」义不明，疑为「渺」「眇」之讹）
entries.en: to talk nonsense; to rave
entries.notes: M 栏原稿残缺，仅 L 栏与 R 栏 miâo 可据，H 栏「渵」为罕见字、语义无定，释义存疑。

entries.zh: 莽撞；言行粗率失当
entries.en: rash; reckless; to act or speak wildly

entries.zh: 糊涂；言语混乱不清
entries.en: muddled; to talk confusedly
entries.notes: H 栏「糊」单字为词头，取「糊塗」混淆之义；M 栏后半（hāy algùn mahndo）残损不辨。

entries.zh: 乱七八糟地；错乱无序地
entries.en: confusedly; disorderly; nonsensically

entries.zh: 荒谬悖理；言语乖戾失当
entries.en: absurd and perverse; to speak wildly and offensively
entries.notes: R 栏 mīn tùi 与「謬戾」对音不合，M 栏残损，L 栏「en la puerta」疑旁注混入正文，四栏难以互证。

entries.zh: 说空话；所言不足信（「城」当为「成」，谓不实之言）
entries.en: to talk nonsense; his words are worth nothing
entries.notes: H 栏「城」为「成」（chiâⁿ/siâⁿ，真实）之借字，R 栏 chēng 可证，正合 L 栏 no vale nada lo que dice。

entries.zh: 纷嚷；如疯子般乱喊乱叫
entries.en: to clamor; to rave like a madman

entries.zh: 妄做；行事荒唐（「三」疑为记音字）
entries.en: to act absurdly; to behave foolishly
entries.notes: H 栏「三做」不成常语，而 M/R 两栏 sām chô 与 L 栏「行为荒唐」相合，疑「三」为记音字（参第 10 条）。

entries.zh: 胡言乱语（字面「吐龙涎」，语义待考）
entries.en: to talk nonsense (lit. 'to spit dragon's saliva'; sense uncertain)
entries.notes: 「吐龍涎」字面义与 disparatar 之关联不明，M 栏尾附西语残片（gazaufin、Humay、el Hon）不辨，不敢定夺。
